title: euphrasia × brevipila f. eglandulosa
intro: Euphrasia × brevipila f. eglandulosa, commonly known as a type of Eyebright plant, is a hybrid species with various health benefits attributed to it. The plant is believed to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it potentially useful in treating eye infections and soothing irritated eyes. The therapeutic actions of Euphrasia × brevipila f. eglandulosa are said to include reducing swelling and promoting the healing of tissues, as well as exhibiting antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that are thought to contribute to its therapeutic properties.
